messages:
maria: heads-up — saw a spike in 'flip rate' for the AWQ quantized gpt-neox-20b during last night's dedicated traffic run. FP8 baseline flip_rate ~0.4%, AWQ (group=64, actq=4) flip_rate ~1.8% and occasional short output flicker. not a full regression but enough to fail some eval slices :grimacing:
aj: ugh, can you paste the small sample + link to perf dashboard? :eyes: which eval slice triggers it? aj: also curious about latencies/throughput on that run
samir: i can reproduce locally. ran a quick loop against eval_set_v2 with the same quant args. command i used:
```
python eval.py --model gpt-neox-20b --quant awq --group 64 --actq 4 --dataset eval_set_v2 --seed 42 --batch 8
```
repro is consistent for ~1k examples — same flip patterns on long-prefix prompts
kevin: let's do a small grid: group sizes [8,16,32,64,128], actq [2,3,4]. collect flip_rate, top1-delta, nll_reg, p95 latency. if AWQ wins perf but loses >0.5% flip_rate vs FP8/GPTQ we shouldn't default it for prod.
lisa: note: i saw flip spikes when prefix_cache wasn't warmed — could be KV warmstart effect. canary id 2026-03-awq-run had prefix len 1024 for many tests. worth testing short vs long prefixes
ci-bot: DeployBot: canary deployed awq-group-32-actq-3 to staging (canary_id=stg-2101, started 2101239900) :white_check_mark:
maria: quick numbers from my staging sweep (small sample, 2k ex):
- FP8 baseline: flip_rate 0.41%, p95 latency 160ms
- AWQ g32 a3: flip_rate 0.62%, p95 175ms (+15ms)
- AWQ g64 a4: flip_rate 2.10%, p95 145ms (throughput jump but more flips)
so tradeoff looks non-linear with group size and actq combo
aj: ok that G64 A4 is noisy. proposal: set soft cap group_size<=32 for hosted/Dedicated by default and enable fallback to GPTQ for customers flagged for high-accuracy (enterprise) until we root cause
samir: i'll run a full bakeoff overnight across FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ using the canonical eval suite (slices: long-prefix, math, instruction-following, coding). will log per-slice flip_rate, token-entropy, and topk deltas. timeline: start tonight, finish ~tomorrow morning, publish spreadsheet
kevin: add metrics: per-token entropy change, LM accuracy delta, and sample-level catastrophic-flip count (where final answer changes category). also track cache-warmstart flips (run with and without prefix cache warm)
lisa: can we add a short canary config to the console to watch real traffic? i can hook tracing to capture a few near-miss traces and annotate them for ops.
maria: for immediate mitigation i'm going to: 1) roll back awq g64 a4 from prod canaries, 2) set default group_size=32 on new AWQ variants, 3) open an ENG-ML issue with links to staging runs and samir's overnight job
aj: thanks. please tag eng-sre and product when you open the issue so rollout policy is synced
samir: starting the overnight jobs now, will attach raw eval logs + a short summary sheet. if anyone wants raw inputs to rerun locally say so
kevin: after bakeoff let's run a small AB test with per-client routing: AWQ for cheap/low-risk, GPTQ for high-accuracy. measure real-user QoE for a week
lisa: nice plan. :thumbsup: i'll prep the tracing hooks and a short alert for flip_rate > 1%
maria: thanks team — we'll regroup after samir's report and decide on the default AWQ knobs. if you see odd regression in other models ping this thread
